title: Giants on the Frontier — Chapter 1 scaffold
tagline: Play your owned SKT Chapter 1 notes: fill YOUR NOTE fields and campaignGuide from your book. SRD monsters only in repo.
sourceNote: Not official WotC content. Copy to content/private/skt-nightstone via npm run module:scaffold
campaignGuide: YOUR NOTE: Paste 5–15 bullet points from your book — plot hooks, NPC names you use at the table, village name, where giants fit in. Do not paste full paragraphs from the PDF into git.

settlement-arrival.goal: Reach the settlement and learn that something catastrophic happened.
settlement-arrival.starter: Rain hammers a walled settlement. A bell tolls — too fast, too urgent.
choices: Talk to guards at the gate
settlement-arrival.guidance: YOUR NOTE: settlement name, who greets PCs, one hook sentence from your book.

village-briefing.goal: Gather concrete facts: who is missing, what was stolen, what witnesses saw.
village-briefing.starter: Candlelight and mud-stained maps cover a table. Survivors speak in half-sentences.
village-briefing.guidance: YOUR NOTE: key NPC names you use, 2–3 facts players should learn. DC 12–14 social.

breach-investigation.goal: Examine the breach, debris, or kidnapping site for clues.
breach-investigation.starter: The wall is shattered at an impossible height. Scorch marks and claw-gouges remain.
breach-investigation.guidance: YOUR NOTE: clue on success. Investigation or Perception DC from your book.

trail-to-hideout.goal: Follow the trail toward the next location in your chapter.
trail-to-hideout.starter: Tracks lead away from the walls — boot prints, wagon ruts, or something stranger.
trail-to-hideout.guidance: YOUR NOTE: destination name, Survival/Stealth DC, complication on fail.

goblin-ambush.goal: Survive the ambush — in many tables this is goblins/orcs before larger threats.
goblin-ambush.starter: Arrows hiss from the rocks! Small shapes dart between boulders.
choices: Try to intimidate them to flee
goblin-ambush.guidance: YOUR NOTE: adjust sceneEncounters below if your book uses different foes.

endingMessage: YOUR NOTE: one sentence chapter cliffhanger from your book — or 'Rest and level up; continue in your next module.'

npcs.name: YOUR NOTE: leader name
knowledge: YOUR NOTE: fact about the attack
YOUR NOTE: fact about missing people

npcs.name: YOUR NOTE: witness name
npcs.description: YOUR NOTE: who saw the giants or raiders
knowledge: YOUR NOTE: direction enemies came from

mock.socialSuccess: YOUR NOTE: what they reveal when persuaded.
mock.socialFailure: YOUR NOTE: deflection until trust is earned.
mock.explorationSuccess: YOUR NOTE: clue found on success.
mock.explorationFailure: YOUR NOTE: muddy result; player can retry.
mock.canonFactOnSocialSuccess: YOUR NOTE: one canon sentence for the log.
